prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web composition study for the complete GameWake experience
Primary request: Create composition option C for the GameWake redesign, showing the landing page first viewport as the dominant 70% of the canvas and a coordinated Web Console preview in the remaining 30%. This is a shippable interface mockup, not a poster, scene, device mockup, or mood board.
Structure: slim navigation; a bold editorial landing organized like a shared Friday-night run sheet. The first viewport is a vertically staggered sequence of large functional bands: invite the group, wake the World, see the exact session state, protect the save. A huge Portuguese headline overlaps the first two bands without reducing legibility. The Discord CTA is the only hard-shadow action. Below the fold, show the beginning of a dark wallet section and a calm backup section. The Console preview must look like an operational run sheet: fixed World header, one highlighted current task, clear next action, friend presence and wallet balance in a narrow supporting column, with detailed panels behaving as drawers rather than a KPI dashboard.
Visual system: GameWake "Sala de Controle dos Amigos"; warm mist paper #f4f5ef, night ink #0b1020, wake green #b8f43d, journey indigo #606bf3, preparation amber #ffb44a, attention coral #ff7164. Flat operational surfaces, thin dividers, one hard offset shadow for the primary action, ambient depth only for overlays. Geist-like geometric sans, tight bold display, small monospaced metadata.
Text (verbatim, only these phrases need to be legible): "GameWake", "Chama a turma. A gente acorda o World.", "Entrar com Discord", "Palpagos", "Dormindo com segurança", "Acordar World", "R$ 42,80".
Composition/framing: 16:9 desktop browser canvas, edge-to-edge interface, no laptop or phone frame, enough visible second-fold content to prove the system, extremely polished spacing and hierarchy.
Constraints: preserve product truth, controls must look usable, operational state must be instantly scannable, accessible contrast, no invented testimonials or customer logos.
Avoid: generic corporate cloud dashboard, AWS-like metrics wall, neon/eSports gamer aesthetics, glassmorphism everywhere, gradients, black full-page background, floating rounded cards everywhere, decorative 3D objects, stock illustration, photographic scene, unreadable tiny text, extra slogans, watermarks.
